text:
Tanvi S: Heads up — last night's hygiene sweep playbook ran twice for a subset of accounts and reassigned owners. Getting a few angry threads from PMs.

Ben R: omg saw that in my inbox. Which playbook and how many accounts?

Tanvi S: playbook id pb-2024-09-contact-dedupe. Ran at 02:07 and 02:08. ops-bot logs show duplicate webhook fires:
```
2026-02-12T02:07:12Z pb-2024-09 START run_id=abc123
2026-02-12T02:08:30Z pb-2024-09 START run_id=abc124
2026-02-12T02:08:31Z webhook received duplicate event id=evt-789
```

Maya P: looks like the webhook consumer didn't dedupe by event id. Is this the same pattern we fixed in seq-runner last quarter? :thinking_face: 

Ben R: could be. Short-term — can we roll back the reassigns for the high-touch accounts? Need to reduce churn.

Tanvi S: list (redacted): ACC-9, ACC-18, ACC-77, ACC-102. I can run a revert script via ops-bot but need owner confirmation before we flip back.

Priya (CS Ops): I can reach out to the owners now. Also proposing a two-part fix: (1) add idempotency check in webhook consumer for event_id, (2) add a per-playbook run lock so overlapping starts are skipped.

Ben R: +1. Also add a config param overlap_window_minutes — if a run starts within N minutes of previous START, treat it as duplicate unless forced.

Maya P: agree. Metrics too — increment duplicate_start counter so we can alert if this recurs.

Priya (CS Ops): implementation idea: generate run_token = sha256(playbook_id + event_id). Persist to Redis with TTL = overlap_window_minutes. Consumer checks and bail if token exists. Fallback: if run_id already recorded in run history table, skip.

Tanvi S: sounds safe. I can put a quick patch in runner to check run_token and event_id. Need a deploy window since this is infra-touching.

Ben R: I'll draft a tiny RFC and include rollback plan + monitoring. Hotfix target: today EOD if owners confirm revert is safe. Otherwise schedule compensating job tomorrow morning.

Maya P: Owners pinged. Also I've paused pb-2024-09 in the playbook admin UI for now :pause_button: — prevents further accidental runs.

ops-bot: noted — playbook pb-2024-09 paused by Maya P at 2026-02-12T09:12:10Z. Revert helper script available at /ops/scripts/revert_playbook_owner.sh (requires ops role).

Ben R: thanks. Action items:
- Ben: RFC + deploy plan (ETA 6 hours)
- Tanvi: PR for run_token check + unit tests
- Priya: confirm owners and run revert if approved
- Maya: keep playbook paused until hotfix lands

Tanvi S: will also add a short-runbook for CS Ops to handle incidents like this (how to detect duplicate starts, manual revert steps).

Maya P: thanks team. Keep updates here. :eyes:
